reason: GAPIT MLMM aborts with "the leading minor of order 1 is not positive" -- the variance-component fit is not positive definite. Est-Clines control: R2(PC1~temp)=0.92, so the environment and PC1 are nearly the same variable and the kinship+covariate system is collinear by construction. Fails on the maf 0.01 arm; the maf 0.05 arm reached c5, i.e. dropping low-frequency SNPs improves conditioning enough for it to fit. Excluded on both arms so the ladder is one method set throughout. Both Est-Clines seeds are controls and take no part in any cross-seed vote.

Same failure and same reason as 1231578 (R2(PC1~temp)=0.94), observed on the maf 0.05 arm at c1. SUPER also reports a failure on these two seeds ("invalid value specified for graphical parameter yaxp") but still writes its results table, so it is NOT excluded.
